body:
ONE capybara model (body: "Real, game style"). Only colour variants are allowed. Faces only from the other versions. Karolis, 30 Oct.
LEFT, good moods (you said these are good): Normal, Curious, Very happy, Content, Tired, Yawn, Lies down, Asleep, Wakes up.
RIGHT, bad moods (redone, much sadder):
- Sad: head and ears droop low, a big sigh, a blue tear.
- Lonely: walks up to you, looks up sadly with a tear, nudges your leg.
- Hungry: noses the EMPTY bowl and pushes it, sits, a tear.
- Bored: nudges its ball once, sighs, flops with its chin by the ball.
- Very sad (ignored a long time): lies flat, head on the ground, tears, slow breaths.
- Cheers up: you came back, happy face and a little hop.
Lying is a pose of the same body. Body language only, no text (pet decision 15).
Stage: 2, pet brain.
Friends see this move too (Plan, 31 Oct: pets are sent online for real).

comments.text: Fixed from your note "ONLY EXPRESSIONS ARE GOOD, MODEL SHOULD BE ONLY ONE, except colour differences": the 13 capybaras are gone. Now it is one capybara (the Real, game-style body) going through its moods in one 12-second loop. Only the face and the pose change. The cute set is dropped. Viewer: the same body in every frame. Minor: the blush is faint, and Content looks close to Normal.
all positive emotions are good. the negatives needs more

Read your Redo ("all positive emotions are good, the negatives need more"). Kept the good moods as they were (left). Redid the bad moods (right) much sadder: drooping head and ears, big sighs, blue tears, the empty bowl pushed around, a sulky flop by the ball, and lying flat when ignored for a long time. Viewer: Sad, Hungry, Bored and Very sad read clearly. Lonely reads as sad but weaker. Minor: the small mouth always looks a bit smiley (that is the model's mouth; only the Living chat can add a sad mouth).

source: chat 30 Oct: from your note "save those versions for movements" (Living things chat board row)
title: Capybara moods: one capybara, good and bad moods
